drums.tags: Indie rock with a lo-fi aesthetic. A clean electric guitar plays a repetitive, syncopated four-chord progression using palm-muted eighth notes. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar with a rounded, warm tone. Drums consist of a tight, dry snare and a steady kick drum pattern with occasional eighth-note fills on the rack tom. A second electric guitar enters with a bright, jangly tone playing melodic lead lines in the upper register. The tempo is 112 BPM in the key of G Major and 4/4 time signature.

[Bridge]
[lead guitar drops out]
[palm-muted guitar continues with bass and drums]

[Outro]

[final snare hit and guitar ring out]

bass.tags: Hardcore punk. Distorted electric guitar plays rapid down-stroked power chords in a constant eighth-note rhythm. The bass guitar follows the guitar progression with a thick, overdriven tone. Drums utilize a fast d-beat pattern with a prominent, uncompressed snare and constant eighth-note hi-hat hits. Vocals are shouted with a raspy, aggressive delivery and minimal melodic variation. The recording has a raw, lo-fi aesthetic with high-frequency saturation. 180 BPM. Key of E minor. 4/4 time signature.
